Full summary: Integrated 4 parallel work streams into main for 2.0.0-beta.2: #30 cross-post removal, #31 superseded_by back-links + backfill, #34 priority_weights normalization, #35 archive compaction. Suite 1113 passed, eval gate 0.8909 (no regression vs beta.1), plugin 1.11.1 doc sync.
Decisions: Chose patch-based integration (git apply --3way of each worktree's diff onto main) over committing in worktrees and merging — worktree .twining sentinels were stale (teammate records went to the shared main .twining), so worktree commits would fight the pre-commit hook; patches keep the controller-commits convention intact. One conflict at the predicted housekeeping.ts seam, resolved by keeping #31's backfill as pass 9 and renumbering #35's compaction to pass 10.; Chose a single 2.0.0-beta.2 changelog section framing the release as the v2.0 issue-burndown beta — four issues, four parallel agent work streams — rather than folding entries into the beta.1 section; beta.1 header also corrected from 'unreleased' to its actual 2026-07-05 ship date.; Chose to add a pretest npm hook running inject-posthog-key.mjs — supersede-31's discovered need; fresh worktrees failed test/analytics without a prior build; zero-risk one-liner under the opportunistic-debt rule.
Findings: Agent-resume quirk: archive-35, resumed after an API disconnect, did its work inside weights-34's worktree instead of its own — the two diffs were co-located. Harmless here (combined suite was green) but worth knowing: a resumed background agent may not reattach to its original worktree.; Eval gate for beta.2: synthetic OVERALL 0.8909 — byte-identical to the beta.1 baseline — and holdout runner 42/42. #30's cross-post removal did not move assembly quality, confirming the mirrors were dead weight on the read path.; warning: deepMerge in src/config.ts silently drops user keys absent from DEFAULT_CONFIG for ALL config sections (target-key iteration) — weights-34 handled it for priority_weights only; still latent elsewhere.; need: supersedes is not validated at write time the way 1.24.0 validates depends_on — housekeeping backfill reports dangles it finds; write-time validation is a candidate 2.x follow-up.
